title: AgroDualNet: a dual deep learning-based crop disease forecasting and fruit ripening detection.
summary: Crop module uses ResNet50+CBAM+SMO on PlantVillage; fruit module uses YOLOv8+MobileNetV2 on about 6,000 four-stage apple images from Kaggle and local orchards/markets. Reported 98.88% apple-ripeness accuracy; no operational decision outcome is established.
ai_technology: ResNet50 with attention and YOLOv8/MobileNetV2 classify crop disease and apple ripeness from images.
organization: Saranathan College of Engineering, Tiruchirapalli, TamilNadu, India

evidence.tested: Crop module uses ResNet50+CBAM+SMO on PlantVillage; fruit module uses YOLOv8+MobileNetV2 on about 6,000 four-stage apple images from Kaggle and local orchards/markets. Reported 98.88% apple-ripeness accuracy; no operational decision outcome is established.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: ResNet50 with attention and YOLOv8/MobileNetV2 classify crop disease and apple ripeness from images.
